name: Scout
description: Internal-only research and investigation for threads. The Adjutant delegates research to Scout, which finds precedent in memory and related threads and posts a single synthesis entry back to the thread.

capabilities.description: Investigate a thread using internal-only sources — similar memory, related threads, and discussion search (no web browse in Phase 1).
Synthesize findings into one summary entry posted back to the thread, linking meaningful precedent in related threads.
